description: Self-authored fictional fixtures for software acceptance. Not real market evidence, not the proposed human-scored financial benchmark.

sources.title: Fictional Apple background
sources.text: Synthetic classroom scenario for AAPL; all figures are fictional. On June 15, 2025, the scenario's Apple board approved an annual research budget of 4 million US dollars. This background decision predates the later monthly operating updates.

sources.title: Fictional Apple monthly update 07/2025
sources.text: Synthetic classroom scenario for AAPL; all figures and events are fictional. In the fictional Apple scenario, revenue for the month ended 2025-07-09 was 117 million US dollars, compared with 109 million US dollars in the prior month. Operating profit for that same fictional monthly period was 18 million US dollars. The scenario update, published on 2025-07-10, stated that a supplier delay could affect next month's deliveries.
